name: privilege-bulk-users-lab
description: Privilege Bulk Users LAB: a guide and a runnable lab for registering users for PingOne Privilege by API, in bulk. Route A: PingOne Management API (read, create, add to the Privilege group). Route B: Privilege console API POST /v1/users. Mock by default; Real is owner-run.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
